reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment was proposed — consistent with the expectation for a compliant finding (text is unchanged in the rendered redline).

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: paragraph 5 sets a revenue-share model with no committed Customer fees, and no liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum/early-termination fee payable by Customer appears anywhere in the cited text.

Paragraph 4(a)'s entitlement of Kubient to 'all fees generated during the termination period' is a share of revenue actually earned during the 90-day notice period, not a pre-agreed damages amount, and it is disapplied on termination for material breach — correctly characterized as meeting the preferred position rather than a Customer-payable LD.
The rationale appropriately notes the exhibits are not in scope and flags the fallback cap (3 months' fees) as a conditional caveat without over-flagging.
